run_linear_crf_training: run the linear chain CRF example to train and evaluate a sequence labeling model with SGD
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a CRF model with a given number of output classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph mapping input features to output classes for a CRF model
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a linear chain CRF model using Viterbi decoding with random input lengths
compute_crf_loss: compute the negative log likelihood loss for a CRF model given input and target sequences
